verdict.rationale: AWS docs confirm IAM supports JSON policies with multiple types (identity-based, resource-based, VPC endpoint, permissions boundaries), attaching policies to identities or resources, and using roles/OIDC federation for temporary, scoped credentials — all core building blocks of least privilege. However the evidence pack does not explicitly document IAM policy 'condition' keys, ARN-level resource scoping examples, or the formal policy evaluation logic (explicit deny > allow, evaluation order across policy types) that a security engineer would need to verify least-privilege enforcement. missing for 10: explicit condition-key documentation, resource ARN scoping examples, documented policy evaluation algorithm.
